dossier_meta.statement_text: Does every Eulerian digraph have a majority 3-colouring?
dossier_meta.context_text: For Eulerian digraphs $G$ where every vertex $v$ has equal in- and out-degree $\deg(v)$, Lovász's result for undirected graphs gives a majority 4-colouring, and an analogous argument yields a 3-colouring in which each vertex $v$ has at most $\frac{2}{3}\deg(v)$ same-colour in-or-out-neighbours, proving a special case of Open Problem 1. Whether a full majority 3-colouring (with $\frac{1}{2}\deg^+(v)$) exists for all Eulerian digraphs is open.
